li.p: This vehicle is not equipped with a conventional 12V battery that requires regular replacement. Instead, it uses a lithium-ion battery integrated into the HEV high voltage battery system. A battery protection function is provided, which automatically disconnects the battery from vehicle power draw to prevent complete discharge.

When the vehicle is started (READY indicator ON), the battery is charged regardless of whether the engine is running. Even if no engine sound is heard, it is not necessary to depress the accelerator pedal.

The use of external power accessories may affect vehicle performance and functionality. In particular, the use of a dash camera may result in vehicle power being turned off before the dash camera completes its automatic shutdown.
